literal: Even though fighting spirit and strength are absent, an army will obtain greatness by its imposing military appearance.
translation: Even if it lacks active fighting spirit and physical strength, an army can still win glory through its imposing appearance and orderly array.
modern: போரிடும் தன்மையும் வலிமையும் இல்லை என்றாலும், ஒரு படை தனது அணிவகுப்பின் கம்பீரத்தினால் பெருமை பெறும்.
explanation: This couplet highlights the psychological value of a disciplined and well-organized military force. Even if the soldiers temporarily lack active fighting spirit (அடல்தகை) or physical strength (ஆற்றல்), the sheer sight of a grand, orderly battle-array (படைத்தகை) can command respect and deter enemies. The word 'தகை' in 'படைத்தகை' refers to the imposing appearance, dignity, and traditional prestige of the army. Thus, structure, discipline, and visual majesty alone can sometimes win the day and bring glory (பாடு) to the state.
